# ts-libs

> Small TypeScript libraries on web standards, for the server and the browser, published to JSR
> as `@spy4x/*`. 8 packages cover validation, time zones, email, networking, server
> primitives, realtime and more. Each one is a Deno workspace member with no UI.

## When to use

Before writing a helper of your own, look for it below: it may already exist under another name.
Import it, and if it falls short, extend it in the library rather than keeping a copy.

## How to install

`deno add jsr:@spy4x/<package>`, then import a name from the entry point listed with it, for
example `import { parseIp } from "@spy4x/net/ip"`. Every package carries the same version.
The full READMEs are in [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spy4x/ts-libs/main/llms-full.txt).

## @spy4x/email

### `jsr:@spy4x/email`

- `Canonicalization` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Which canonicalization RFC 6376 §3.4 applies to a header or a body.
- `ConsoleSenderOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Where the dev adapter writes and how much of the body it keeps.
- `DARK_HTML_SHELL_THEME` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The look `htmlWrap` had before HtmlShellOptions.theme existed: a dark navy body with light text and an orange brand link, ported as-is from `mig`.
- `DEFAULT_HTML_SHELL_THEME` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: `htmlWrap`'s default look: a neutral light shell with no product association, so a caller gets a plain, readable letter unless it asks for something else.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_HEADER_FIELDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Default DkimVerifyOptions.maxHeaderFields.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Default DkimVerifyOptions.maxMessageLength: 10 MiB of octets, which is above the message size limit relays usually impose and far below anything that takes a noticeable time to canonicalize.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_SIGNATURES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Default DkimVerifyOptions.maxSignatures.
- `DEFAULT_MAX_SIGNED_HEADER_NAMES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Default DkimVerifyOptions.maxSignedHeaderNames.
- `DkimAlgorithm` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Signature algorithms this verifier implements (RFC 6376 §3.3, RFC 8463).
- `DkimBodyCoverage` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: How much of the canonicalized body a signature's `bh=` tag actually covers.
- `DkimKeyAlgorithm` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Key algorithms a DNS TXT record's `k=` tag may name.
- `DkimParseError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Thrown for a malformed DKIM-Signature header or DNS key record.
- `DkimPublicKey` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: A DKIM public key extracted from a DNS TXT record.
- `DkimSignatureHeader` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Parsed `DKIM-Signature` header value.
- `DkimVerificationResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Outcome of verifyDkim.
- `DkimVerifyOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Options for verifyDkim and fetchDkimPublicKey.
- `DnsTxtResolver` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: DNS TXT lookup contract, defaulting to `Deno.resolveDns(name, "TXT")`, which needs `--allow-net`.
- `EmailAddress` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: A parsed mailbox: the addr-spec, plus the display name that preceded it.
- `EmailAttachment` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: One attachment: text content plus the metadata the MIME part needs.
- `EmailButtonOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: What emailButton needs.
- `EmailMessage` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Everything one send needs.
- `EmailSender` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The port every transport implements, and the only thing callers depend on.
- `HtmlShellOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Everything the shell interpolates around a body.
- `HtmlShellTheme` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The four colours htmlWrap draws the shell in.
- `IcalAttachmentOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The fields of an ICS attachment the caller must supply.
- `ListUnsubscribe` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The `List-Unsubscribe` targets of one message.
- `MIN_RSA_KEY_BITS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: RFC 8301 §3.2: "Verifiers MUST NOT consider signatures using RSA keys of less than 1024 bits as valid."
- `ParsedRecipients` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The recipient list after parsing: deduplicated, with what was dropped recorded.
- `REDACTED_CREDENTIAL` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Placeholder that replaces a credential in any string this module reports.
- `SendFailure` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: No mail was sent, or some recipient was refused.
- `SendResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Outcome of one send attempt.
- `SendSuccess` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Every recipient the transport saw was accepted by the server.
- `SmtpOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Connection settings.
- `SmtpSendInfo` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The slice of a nodemailer send result this adapter reads.
- `SmtpTransport` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: The slice of a nodemailer transport this adapter calls.
- `SmtpTransportFactory` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Builds a transport from a connection configuration.
- `TRANSIT_ADDED_HEADER_NAMES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Header field names a relay is expected to add to a message in transit.
- `assertNoControlCharacters` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Reject a value that carries a control character — CR and LF above all.
- `assertSendableMessage` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Validate a message before any transport sees it.
- `canonicalizeBody` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Canonicalize a message body per RFC 6376 §3.4.3 (simple) / §3.4.4 (relaxed).
- `canonicalizeHeader` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Canonicalize one header field per RFC 6376 §3.4.1 (simple) / §3.4.2 (relaxed).
- `createConsoleSender` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: A sender that logs instead of sending, for local runs and for tests that need a port implementation without a mail server.
- `createSmtpSender` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Create a sender for one SMTP configuration.
- `emailButton` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: A table-based "bulletproof" call-to-action button for the body of a mail.
- `escapeHtml` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Escape a value for interpolation into HTML element text or a double-quoted attribute.
- `fetchDkimPublicKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Fetch and parse a DKIM public key from DNS, from `<selector>._domainkey.<domain>`.
- `formatAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Render a mailbox for a log line or a plain-text body.
- `frameInstantLong` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Render an instant as the recipient's own clock reads it, with the zone spelled out: `"Friday, 28 August 2026 at 04:00 (America/New_York)"`.
- `frameInstantShort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: frameInstantLong without the zone name, for a subject line: `"Fri 28 Aug 04:00"`.
- `frameWallClockLong` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Frame a `YYYY-MM-DD` + `HH:MM` wall clock written in `sourceTz` for a recipient in `recipientTz`, falling back to the zone the wall clock was written in.
- `frameWallClockShort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: frameWallClockLong without the zone name, for a subject line.
- `hasBody` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: True when a body field carries something worth sending.
- `htmlWrap` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Wrap a body in the shared letter-shaped shell.
- `icalAttachment` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Build the ICS attachment for an event.
- `isAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: True when `value` is an addr-spec this module will send to.
- `parseAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Parse `Name <addr>` or a bare addr-spec into its parts.
- `parseAddresses` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Parse a recipient list, deduplicating case-insensitively.
- `parseDkimPublicKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Parse a DKIM TXT record's `p=` field into a public key.
- `parseDkimSignature` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Parse a `DKIM-Signature` header value (without the leading `DKIM-Signature:`) into structured form.
- `refuseHeaderLineEndings` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Refuse a header block whose line endings are not uniform, and say why.
- `sha256Base64` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Compute the base64 SHA-256 digest of a string or of raw octets.
- `splitMessage` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Split a raw RFC 5322 message into raw header lines and a raw body.
- `verifyDkim` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Verify a message's DKIM signatures and report one verdict.
- `verifyDkimSignatures` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email`: Verify every `DKIM-Signature` field in the message and return one result each, in the order the fields appear.

### `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`

- `EmailAddress` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: A parsed mailbox: the addr-spec, plus the display name that preceded it.
- `MAX_ADDR_SPEC_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: Longest addr-spec, in characters, that fits a `RCPT TO` path (RFC 5321 §4.5.3.1.3: 256 with the angle brackets).
- `ParsedRecipients` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: The recipient list after parsing: deduplicated, with what was dropped recorded.
- `assertNoControlCharacters` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: Reject a value that carries a control character — CR and LF above all.
- `formatAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: Render a mailbox for a log line or a plain-text body.
- `isAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: True when `value` is an addr-spec this module will send to.
- `parseAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: Parse `Name <addr>` or a bare addr-spec into its parts.
- `parseAddresses` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/email/address`: Parse a recipient list, deduplicating case-insensitively.

## @spy4x/integrations

### `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`

- `BackoffFn` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Computes a delay.
- `Clock` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Millisecond time source.
- `CloudflarePurgeOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Options for purgeUrls.
- `CloudflarePurgeResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Outcome of a purge: `output` describes what happened on success, `error` on failure.
- `DEFAULT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Bounds a single outgoing request, used by every client in this package unless a caller overrides it.
- `HealthchecksClient` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: healthchecks.io client.
- `HealthchecksClientConfig` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Where to ping, for HealthchecksClient.
- `HealthchecksClientOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Construction-time overrides for HealthchecksClient, all optional and test-injectable.
- `HealthchecksErrorCode` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Failure reasons `ping` can report.
- `HealthchecksFailure` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A ping that could not be delivered after retrying.
- `HealthchecksOutcome` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Which endpoint a ping targets.
- `HealthchecksPing` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: One ping to send through HealthchecksClient.ping.
- `HealthchecksResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Outcome of HealthchecksClient.ping.
- `HealthchecksRetryOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Overrides for the client's default retry policy.
- `HealthchecksSuccess` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A ping that reached healthchecks.io and was accepted.
- `NotificationSeverity` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Severity gate.
- `NtfyClient` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: ntfy client.
- `NtfyClientConfig` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Where to push and how to authenticate, for NtfyClient.
- `NtfyClientOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Construction-time overrides for NtfyClient, all optional and test-injectable.
- `NtfyErrorCode` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Failure reasons `push` can report.
- `NtfyFailure` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A push that could not be delivered after retrying.
- `NtfyPriority` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: ntfy priority, 1 (min) to 5 (max).
- `NtfyPush` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: One notification to send through NtfyClient.push.
- `NtfyPushed` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A push that reached ntfy and was accepted.
- `NtfyResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Outcome of NtfyClient.push.
- `NtfyRetryOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Overrides for the client's default retry policy.
- `NtfySkipped` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A push that was never sent because its severity did not meet the gate.
- `PURGE_BATCH_SIZE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Cloudflare's purge-by-URL endpoint accepts at most this many files per call.
- `RandomSource` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: A source of numbers in `[0, 1)`, the shape `Math.random` has.
- `RetryPolicy` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`
- `RetryRunOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`
- `RetryRunResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`
- `Sleeper` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Waits a duration.
- `WebhookRejectReason` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Why a delivery was rejected.
- `WebhookVerifierConfig` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Shared secret and header names verifyWebhookRequest needs to check a delivery.
- `WebhookVerifyResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Result of verifyWebhookRequest: the verified body, or why it was rejected.
- `createExponentialBackoff` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Exponential backoff, clamped and optionally jittered.
- `describeTransportError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Describes a transport failure **without** the request URL.
- `healthchecksConfigFromEnv` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Reads a ping URL from an environment reader.
- `isPermanentStatus` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Statuses that will never succeed on a retry: the request itself is wrong.
- `isRequestTimeout` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: True when `cause` is the `TimeoutError` an `AbortSignal.timeout()` firing produces.
- `isTransientStatus` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Statuses worth another attempt: rate limiting and upstream faults.
- `ntfyConfigFromEnv` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Reads ntfy settings from an environment reader.
- `parseRetryAfterMs` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Parses a `Retry-After` header.
- `purgeUrls` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Purges `urls` from a Cloudflare zone, 30 per call, and reports the outcome.
- `releaseResponseBody` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Releases a response's body without reading it.
- `runWithRetry` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Runs `attempt` under `policy`.
- `settle` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Consumes whatever a `Sleeper` returned.
- `verifyWebhookRequest` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations`: Verifies one inbound delivery.

### `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/cloudflare`

- `CloudflarePurgeOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/cloudflare`: Options for purgeUrls.
- `CloudflarePurgeResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/cloudflare`: Outcome of a purge: `output` describes what happened on success, `error` on failure.
- `PURGE_BATCH_SIZE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/cloudflare`: Cloudflare's purge-by-URL endpoint accepts at most this many files per call.
- `purgeUrls` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/cloudflare`: Purges `urls` from a Cloudflare zone, 30 per call, and reports the outcome.

### `jsr:@spy4x/integrations/healthchecks`

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform`

- `AnyError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Every error Result can carry.

- `ConnectionError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The request never reached the server.
- `Crumb` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One entry in the breadcrumb trail a page declares.

- `DEFAULT_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Default window for the throttled JSON saver, in milliseconds.
- `DayOfWeek` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Weekday identifier, Monday-first.
- `Debounced` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Trailing-edge debounce.
- `ERR_MESSAGE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Canonical copy for each category, so the same failure reads the same in every product.
- `Err` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Base shape every error shares: a category and human-readable copy.
- `ErrType` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Kind of a failed operation.
- `FormatTimeOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Options for formatTime.
- `HONEYPOT_FIELD_NAME` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Default `name` of the honeypot field.
- `HOURS_IN_DAY` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Hours in one day.
- `InferSchema` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Value a schema accepts and produces.
- `KeyValueStore` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Minimal synchronous key/value port: the subset of the DOM `Storage` interface a caller needs to persist a small value, and the one shape `@spy4x/platform/browser/storage`'s `StorageLike` and `@spy4x/realtime`'s `KeyValueStore` both alias (#71).
- `MAX_TICKS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Hard ceiling on generated ticks, and on the iterations the tick loop may spend producing them — see the doc of `ticksForStep` (the private loop behind ticks and stepAxis) for why the loop needs its own bound, not just the output's.
- `MILLISECONDS_IN_SECOND` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Milliseconds in one second.
- `MINUTES_IN_HOUR` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Minutes in one hour.
- `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Minimum accepted password length.
- `MONTHS_IN_YEAR` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Months in one year.
- `NowFn` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Monotonic millisecond clock, function-shaped rather than object-shaped — the home for the `() => number` clock shape (`#71`), which cannot be merged into Clock without breaking a 1.x caller of one shape or the other.
- `ONE_DAY_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One day, in milliseconds.
- `ONE_DAY_IN_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One day, in seconds.
- `ONE_HOUR_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One hour, in milliseconds.
- `ONE_HOUR_IN_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One hour, in seconds.
- `ONE_MINUTE_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One minute, in milliseconds.
- `ONE_MONTH_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One month (30 days), in milliseconds.
- `ONE_MONTH_IN_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One month (30 days), in seconds.
- `ONE_WEEK_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One week, in milliseconds.
- `ONE_WEEK_IN_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One week, in seconds.
- `ONE_YEAR_IN_MILLISECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One year (12 nominal months), in milliseconds.
- `ONE_YEAR_IN_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One year (12 nominal months), in seconds.
- `OperationResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Result of an operation that can fail: exactly one of `result` / `error` is non-null.
- `OperationState` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: In-flight state of an operation, for a store or a form to render.
- `OtherError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: An error this package has no category for.
- `PayloadError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: A payload a schema rejected: a response body, or a remote feed item.
- `RandomSource` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: A source of numbers in `[0, 1)`, the shape `Math.random` has.
- `RequestError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Errors a request itself can produce.
- `ResponseError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Errors from a response that never reached a usable body.
- `Result` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: A value or an error, as a discriminated union on `ok`.
- `SECONDS_IN_MINUTE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Seconds in one minute.
- `ServerError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The server answered with a failure status.
- `SortDirection` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Sort direction of one rule.
- `SortRule` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One column in the sort order.
- `StepAxis` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Bounds rounded outward to multiples of a step, and the ticks between them.
- `StoreError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Every error a store operation can settle with.
- `TimeFormatOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Locale and zone applied by formatTime and timeAgo.
- `TimeFormatter` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Format an instant for display.
- `ValidationError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: A rejected input: its kind, one sentence for the user, the issues per field path, and arktype's own errors.
- `backoffDelay` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Caps a raw delay and jitters it — the exponential-backoff arithmetic that used to be implemented twice: once with symmetric jitter around the capped delay (`integrations/retry.ts`'s `createExponentialBackoff`) and once with jitter that only ever shortens the wait (`realtime/backoff.ts`'s `nextBackoffDelay`).
- `breadcrumbItems` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: `itemListElement` for a schema.org `BreadcrumbList`, built from the crumbs the caller stated.
- `breadcrumbListJsonLd` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The complete `BreadcrumbList` node, `@id`-anchored to the page it describes.
- `canonicalUrl` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Parse a canonical address into the normalised `URL` that will be published.
- `commandErr` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Build the failure arm of a CommandEnvelope.
- `commandFromError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Build a CommandEnvelope from a thrown error, keeping the stack out of the payload.
- `commandOk` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Build the success arm of a CommandEnvelope.
- `connectionError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Wrap a message the caller already has into a ConnectionError.
- `convertToKebabCase` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Convert a free-form identifier to kebab-case.
- `debounce` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Wrap `fn` in a trailing-edge debounce.
- `err` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Wrap a failure.
- `filterRows` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Keep the rows that every word of the query matches.
- `formatBytes` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: A byte count for display, in binary (1024) steps: `"512 B"`, `"1.5 KB"`, `"2 MB"`.
- `formatDecimal` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Format a decimal number to exactly two decimal places.
- `formatPct` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Format a fraction in `0..1` as a percentage string with two decimals.
- `formatTime` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One-off TimeFormatter#format on the host clock.
- `getDaysOfWeek` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Read a weekday bitmask into day names.
- `honeypotFilled` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Whether a submitted honeypot field carries a value — a person never types into a field they cannot see, so any value here means whatever posted the form was not one.
- `idleOperationState` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Idle state of an operation.
- `initials` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Reduce a name to one or two initials, e.g. for an avatar's fallback face.
- `isSilentError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Whether an error should stay quiet.
- `isValidDate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Whether the input is a usable date: a `Date` or an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`-prefixed string that `Date` can parse.
- `jsonLdText` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Serialise JSON-LD for a `<script>` body.
- `levenshtein` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Levenshtein edit distance between two strings, computed over code points.
- `niceStep` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Round a span up to a sensible tick step at roughly `target` ticks.
- `normalizeCalendarDate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Normalise `YYYY.MM.DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD` to `YYYY-MM-DD`, rejecting impossible dates.
- `normalizeCanonical` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The canonical address as it should be published: one clean `http`/`https` address.
- `ok` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Wrap a success.
- `parseSort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Read sort rules out of a URL parameter.
- `pluralize` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Naive English pluraliser for UI copy.
- `removeSortRule` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Removes one sort priority while preserving all remaining priorities.
- `responseError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Turn a failed response into a structured error.
- `round` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Round to the nearest 10^-`decimals`.
- `search` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Whether one search word occurs in one value.
- `searchWords` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Split a search box's value into words.
- `serializeSort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Write sort rules into a URL parameter.
- `similarity` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Similarity of two strings in `[0, 1]`, derived from levenshtein.
- `sleep` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Wait `ms` milliseconds.
- `sortRows` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Sort rows by every rule in order.
- `stepAxis` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Round `[min, max]` outward to multiples of `step` and return the new bounds with the ticks between them.
- `systemClock` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The host clock.
- `systemNow` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: The host clock, function-shaped.
- `ticks` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Tick values at multiples of a nice step, kept within half a step of `[min, max]`.
- `timeAgo` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: One-off TimeFormatter#ago on the host clock.
- `toggleSort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Advance one column through `asc` → `desc` → `off`.
- `unwrap` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Narrow a Result to its value, or raise.
- `unwrapOr` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: Narrow a Result to its value, or fall back.
- `utf8ByteLength` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform`: UTF-8 byte length, i.e. what a `Content-Length` or a storage quota counts.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/api`

- `ApiError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/api`: One failure `apiFetch` can report: an HTTP status and a message meant to be shown as-is.
- `ApiResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/api`: Outcome of apiFetch: the parsed body on success, or a typed error on failure.
- `apiFetch` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/api`: `fetch` a JSON API and report the outcome as an ApiResult instead of throwing.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`

- `ClipboardDocument` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The document surface the legacy `execCommand("copy")` path needs.
- `ClipboardWriter` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The one clipboard method this helper calls.
- `CopyToClipboardOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Where copyToClipboard writes.
- `DownloadDocument` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Minimal document surface this helper needs, so the caller passes its own `document`.
- `DownloadOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Everything downloadResponseAsFile needs; all of it injectable.
- `EMBED_HEIGHT_MESSAGE_TYPE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Default `type` of the message reportHeight posts: `{ type, height }`.
- `EmbedMeasurable` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The measured element: anything with a `getBoundingClientRect`.
- `EmbedParent` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The parent frame: all reportHeight needs from it is `postMessage`.
- `EmbedResizeObserver` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The observer reportHeight uses; a `ResizeObserver` fits.
- `EmbedWindow` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The subset of `Window` reportHeight reads.
- `GEOLOCATION_FAILED` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Message requestGeolocation reports when the browser refused or failed to answer.
- `GEOLOCATION_UNSUPPORTED` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Message requestGeolocation reports when the runtime has no `Geolocation` at all.
- `GeoCoordinates` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: A resolved position, reduced to the two numbers a caller stores.
- `Hotkey` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: A parsed keyboard combination: one key and the modifiers held with it.
- `HotkeyEvent` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The part of a `KeyboardEvent` that matchesHotkey reads.
- `MakeStorageOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Options for makeStorage.
- `ObjectUrlAdapter` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Object-URL surface, injected so a test never allocates a real blob URL.
- `PlatformNavigator` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The part of `navigator` that isApplePlatform reads.
- `ReportHeightOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Options for reportHeight.
- `StorageLike` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The subset of the DOM `Storage` interface this module uses.
- `StorageRead` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Outcome of a write or a read, so a caller can tell "absent" from "present but rejected".
- `TimerAdapter` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Timer surface, injected so a test never waits on a real delay.
- `TypedStorage` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: A namespaced handle over one key.
- `TypingTarget` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The part of an element that isTypingTarget reads.
- `captureTimeZone` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: The visitor's IANA time zone (`Europe/Berlin`), or `undefined` when the runtime reports none.
- `copyToClipboard` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Write `text` to the clipboard, and say whether it got there.
- `downloadCsv` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Write rows as a CSV file and save it: toCsvBytes handed to downloadResponseAsFile.
- `downloadResponseAsFile` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Save a response body to disk under `filename`.
- `fillEmptyTimeZoneField` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Put the visitor's time zone into a form field, only when the field is still empty — a zone the page already filled in (from a link's `tz` parameter, say) is what the visitor saw on screen, and overwriting it would submit a different one.
- `getCookie` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Look up `name` in `doc.cookie`, decoding its value.
- `isApplePlatform` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Whether the browser runs on macOS, iOS or iPadOS, where `mod` means Command.
- `isTypingTarget` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Whether a key press on this element is typing: a text `<input>`, a `<textarea>`, a `<select>` or `contenteditable` content.
- `makeStorage` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Bind a StorageLike to one key.
- `matchesHotkey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Whether a key press is the combination.
- `memoryStorage` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: A `Map`-backed StorageLike.
- `parseHotkey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Parse a combination such as `"mod+k"`, `"shift+n"`, `"?"` or `"ctrl+alt+delete"`.
- `reportHeight` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Post the element's height, in whole CSS pixels, to the parent frame — once the page has loaded, and again each time the element's size changes.
- `requestGeolocation` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/browser`: Ask for the current position and report the result.

- `reviveIsoDatesEndingInAt` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cache`: `JSON.parse` reviver that turns a string property whose key ends in `At` into a `Date`, when the string looks like an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`

- `Command` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A write intent: `TPayload` in, `TResult` out.
- `CommandBus` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: Routes a command instance to the one handler registered for its class, and infers the returned value's type from the command class alone — no cast at the call site.
- `CommandConstructor` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A class implementing Command, matched by `CommandBus.register`/`execute`.
- `CommandHandler` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: Handler a CommandBus runs for one command class.
- `CommandResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: The result type a Command class carries, extracted from its phantom `__resultType`.
- `CqrsMiddleware` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A step that runs around every `execute` of a CommandBus or QueryBus, before the handler and whatever transport produced the message.
- `Event` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A fact an EventBus distributes to its subscribers.
- `EventBus` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: In-process publish/subscribe bus for one event class per subscription.
- `EventBusErrorHandler` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: Called when a listener fails — throws synchronously or returns a rejected promise — instead of letting the failure propagate.
- `EventConstructor` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A class implementing Event, matched by `EventBus.on`/`once`/`emit`.
- `Query` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A read intent: `TPayload` in, `TResult` out.
- `QueryBus` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: Routes a query instance to the one handler registered for its class, and infers the returned value's type from the query class alone — no cast at the call site.
- `QueryConstructor` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: A class implementing Query, matched by `QueryBus.register`/`execute`.
- `QueryHandler` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: Handler a QueryBus runs for one query class.
- `QueryResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/cqrs`: The result type a Query class carries, extracted from its phantom `__resultType`.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`

- `KeysetCursorCodec` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: Encodes and decodes one list's cursors.
- `KeysetCursorCodecOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: Settings fixed for the codec's lifetime.
- `KeysetCursorError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: The one error every refusal raises.
- `KeysetCursorErrorCode` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: Why a cursor was refused.
- `ScopeValue` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: A scope value: a string, or a finite number.
- `UpdatedAtIdPageKey` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: The decoded default page key: `{ updatedAt: Date, id: string }`.
- `createKeysetCursorCodec` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: Creates a cursor codec for one list.
- `deriveCursorSecret` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: The cursor signing key for `purpose`: deriveSecret of the master secret under the label `spy4x.keyset-cursor.v1:<purpose>`, 64 hex characters.
- `updatedAtIdPageKey` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/keyset-cursor`: The default page key, `{ updatedAt, id }`: the last row of a page ordered by `updated_at` then `id`.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`

- `BaseModel` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value BaseModelSchema produces.
- `BaseModelSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: UndeletableBaseModelSchema plus a nullable `deletedAt`, for a soft-deletable record.
- `DateNullableSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: dateSchema, also accepting `null` and defaulting to it when the field is absent.
- `DateType` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value dateSchema produces: always a `Date`, regardless of which input form it parsed.
- `ImmutableBaseModelSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: The two fields present on every record: its id and when it was created.
- `PushNotificationMessage` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value pushNotificationMessageSchema produces.
- `PushSubscribeRequest` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value pushSubscribeRequestSchema produces.
- `PushSubscriptionData` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Alias for PushSubscriptionJson used where the wire origin is not the point.
- `PushSubscriptionJson` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value pushSubscriptionSchema produces.
- `PushSubscriptionKeys` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value pushSubscriptionKeysSchema produces.
- `PushUnsubscribeRequest` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Value pushUnsubscribeRequestSchema produces.
- `UndeletableBaseModelSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: ImmutableBaseModelSchema plus `updatedAt`, for a record that can be edited.
- `dateSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: `Date`, or an ISO 8601 date string naming a real calendar date, parsed to a `Date`.
- `pushNotificationMessageSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: A notification the server sends through a push subscription.
- `pushSubscribeRequestSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Request body to register a device's push subscription.
- `pushSubscriptionKeysSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: The two keys a `PushSubscription`'s `getKey` calls produce, base64url-encoded.
- `pushSubscriptionSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: A browser's `PushSubscription`, as `JSON.stringify`d by `PushSubscription.toJSON()`.
- `pushUnsubscribeRequestSchema` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/model`: Request body to drop a device's push subscription.

- `RejectionStatus` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Statuses a rejection may use.
- `RemoteAddrResolver` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Resolve a client's peer address from a runtime handle, for RateLimitMiddlewareOptions.
- `SWEEP_EVERY_CHECKS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: How many requests may arrive between two sweeps before one is forced.
- `StoreRateLimiter` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Store-backed sliding window over any RateLimitStore.
- `TrustedProxyHeader` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: A single proxy header clientIp may be told to trust, in place of the default all-three-headers order.
- `UNKNOWN_CLIENT_IP` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Fallback when no header and no peer address is available.
- `UserThenIpOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Options for userThenIp.
- `clientIp` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Resolve the client IP for a request.
- `clientIpBucket` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: The rate-limit identity of a client address: an IPv6 address reduced to its /64 network (`2001:db8:1:2::/64`), anything else unchanged.
- `createKvStore` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Build a `RateLimitStore` over any RateLimitKv.

- `denoKvBackend` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Deno KV adapter.
- `failOpenLimiter` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Wrap a limiter so that a failing backend lets requests through instead of failing them.
- `humanRetry` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Milliseconds as a human retry hint: `"1 second"`, `"45 seconds"`, `"2 minutes"`.
- `rateLimitKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Build a limiter key from an identity.
- `systemClock` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Default: real time.
- `userThenIp` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/rate-limit`: Key a request on the authenticated user when the caller can find one, else on the client IP.

- `RunCommandStdin` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/server`: Where the child's standard input comes from: the caller's own (`"inherit"`) or nothing (`"null"`, so a read gets end-of-file at once).

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`

- `SignedPayloadCodec` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Signs and verifies one purpose's payloads.
- `SignedPayloadCodecOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Settings fixed for the codec's lifetime.
- `SignedPayloadError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Thrown by SignedPayloadCodec.sign when it would mint a token that `verify` refuses: `InvalidPayload` for a payload that is not JSON or does not survive a JSON round trip through the schema, `Malformed` for a token longer than MAX_SIGNED_PAYLOAD_LENGTH.
- `SignedPayloadErrorCode` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Why a token was refused.
- `VerifyOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Per-token settings for SignedPayloadCodec.verify.
- `createSignedPayloadCodec` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/signed-payload`: Creates a codec for one purpose, version and schema.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`

- `DEFAULT_TOKEN_BYTES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Default raw-token width: 128 bits, which base64url renders as 22 characters.
- `MIN_SECRET_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Smallest accepted secret length, in characters, measured on the trimmed value.
- `TokenError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Typed error for token primitives.
- `TokenErrorCode` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Failure kind of a `TokenError`.
- `ULID_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Length of a ULID string: 26 Crockford base32 characters.
- `constantTimeEquals` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Compares two hex digests in constant time.
- `constantTimeEqualsText` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Compares two arbitrary strings in constant time.
- `deriveSecret` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: A subordinate secret derived from a master secret: HKDF-SHA-256 (RFC 5869) with `secret` as the input key material, the fixed salt `spy4x.derive-secret.v1` and `label` as `info`, 32 bytes as lower-case hex, 64 characters.
- `monotonicUlid` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Generate a ULID that monotonically increases even for the same millisecond, optionally passing the current time.
- `newOpaqueToken` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Mints an opaque token: `raw` goes to the caller, `hash` is what the server stores.
- `randomBase64Url` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Cryptographically random bytes, base64url, unpadded.
- `sha256Hex` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Concatenated digest `sha256hex(raw + secret)`, lower-case, 64 characters.
- `verifyOpaqueToken` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/tokens`: Recomputes `sha256Hex(raw + secret)` and compares it to the stored hash via `constantTimeEquals` — never `===`, never `!==` (the shape that made `offer-lens/libs/auth/mod.ts:115` timing-unsafe).

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`

- `BackoffDelayOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`
- `BackoffJitterMode` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: How backoffDelay spreads a capped delay.
- `Debounced` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: Trailing-edge debounce.
- `RandomSource` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: A source of numbers in `[0, 1)`, the shape `Math.random` has.
- `backoffDelay` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: Caps a raw delay and jitters it — the exponential-backoff arithmetic that used to be implemented twice: once with symmetric jitter around the capped delay (`integrations/retry.ts`'s `createExponentialBackoff`) and once with jitter that only ever shortens the wait (`realtime/backoff.ts`'s `nextBackoffDelay`).
- `debounce` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: Wrap `fn` in a trailing-edge debounce.
- `sleep` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/async`: Wait `ms` milliseconds.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`

- `MAX_TICKS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`: Hard ceiling on generated ticks, and on the iterations the tick loop may spend producing them — see the doc of `ticksForStep` (the private loop behind ticks and stepAxis) for why the loop needs its own bound, not just the output's.
- `StepAxis` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`: Bounds rounded outward to multiples of a step, and the ticks between them.
- `niceStep` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`: Round a span up to a sensible tick step at roughly `target` ticks.
- `stepAxis` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`: Round `[min, max]` outward to multiples of `step` and return the new bounds with the ticks between them.
- `ticks` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/axis`: Tick values at multiples of a nice step, kept within half a step of `[min, max]`.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/concurrency`

- `AsyncMutex` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/concurrency`: A fair mutual-exclusion lock for async critical sections.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/constants`

- `DEFAULT_DEBOUNCE_DELAY` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/constants`: Default trailing-edge debounce delay, in milliseconds.
- `DEFAULT_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/constants`: Default window for the throttled JSON saver, in milliseconds.
- `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/constants`: Minimum accepted password length.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`

- `CSV_BYTE_ORDER_MARK` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: UTF-8 byte-order mark.
- `CsvCellValue` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: What a `format` function, or an unformatted field, may hand back for one cell.
- `CsvColumn` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: One column of a CSV export: the row field to read, its header text, and how to render a value.
- `csvField` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: Render one value as an RFC 4180 CSV cell.
- `csvHeaderRow` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: The header row, escaped the same way a data row is.
- `csvRow` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: One data row, rendered and escaped, comma-joined.
- `toCsvBytes` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: toCsvText, encoded as UTF-8 bytes with a leading CSV_BYTE_ORDER_MARK.
- `toCsvText` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/csv`: Render every row as RFC 4180 CSV text: a header row, one line per row of `rows`, each terminated by LINE_ENDING — including the last line, which the RFC leaves optional but which every row here carries for one uniform rule instead of a special case for the final row.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`

- `AnyError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Every error Result can carry.
- `ConnectionError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: The request never reached the server.
- `ERR_MESSAGE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Canonical copy for each category, so the same failure reads the same in every product.
- `Err` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Base shape every error shares: a category and human-readable copy.
- `ErrType` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Kind of a failed operation.
- `OperationResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Result of an operation that can fail: exactly one of `result` / `error` is non-null.
- `OperationState` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: In-flight state of an operation, for a store or a form to render.
- `OtherError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: An error this package has no category for.
- `PayloadError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: A payload a schema rejected: a response body, or a remote feed item.
- `RequestError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Errors a request itself can produce.
- `ResponseError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Errors from a response that never reached a usable body.
- `ServerError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: The server answered with a failure status.
- `StoreError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Every error a store operation can settle with.
- `ValidationError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: A rejected input: its kind, one sentence for the user, the issues per field path, and arktype's own errors.
- `connectionError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Wrap a message the caller already has into a ConnectionError.
- `idleOperationState` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Idle state of an operation.
- `isSilentError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Whether an error should stay quiet.
- `responseError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/errors`: Turn a failed response into a structured error.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/format-number`

- `formatBytes` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/format-number`: A byte count for display, in binary (1024) steps: `"512 B"`, `"1.5 KB"`, `"2 MB"`.
- `formatDecimal` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/format-number`: Format a decimal number to exactly two decimal places.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/honeypot`

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`

- `MoneyOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: Optional, additive overrides for formatMoney, formatMoneyParts, parseMoney and currencyDecimals.
- `ParseMoneyError` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: Why parseMoney could not turn the typed text into a smallest-unit amount.
- `currencyDecimals` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: How many fraction digits `currency` uses, in `locale`'s own currency display rules.
- `formatMoney` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: Format an amount in `currency`'s smallest unit as display text — `formatMoney(12345, "EUR")` is `"€123.45"`, `formatMoney(12345, "JPY")` is `"¥12,345"`, `formatMoney(12345, "KWD")` is `"KWD 12.345"`.
- `formatMoneyParts` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: formatMoney's output as `Intl.NumberFormatPart`s, for a caller that renders the currency symbol, the grouped digits and the sign as separate pieces instead of one string.
- `moneyDecimalString` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: `amount`, in `currency`'s smallest unit, as the exact base-ten string `Intl.NumberFormat` should format — `moneyDecimalString(12345, 2)` is `"123.45"`, `moneyDecimalString(-500, 0)` is `"-500"`, `moneyDecimalString(0, 2)` is `"0.00"`, `moneyDecimalString(0, 0)` is `"0"` — a zero amount gets `decimals` zero digits after the point, same as any other amount, never a bare `"0"` for a currency that has decimals.
- `parseMoney` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/universal/money`: Parse text typed in `locale` into a whole number of `currency`'s smallest unit — `parseMoney("12,5", "EUR", "de")` is `ok(1250)`, `parseMoney("1.234,56", "EUR", "de")` is `ok(123456)`.

### `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`

- `DEL_CODE_POINT` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: ASCII `DEL`.
- `HEADER_MAX_CODE_POINT` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: Highest ASCII control code point, inclusive: the C0 block.
- `HeaderSafeString` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`
- `HoneypotField` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`
- `TEXT_ALLOWED_CODE_POINTS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: Control code points free text is allowed to keep: TAB, LF and CR.
- `TextSafeString` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`
- `TimeZoneName` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`
- `ValidEmailAddress` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`
- `emailAddress` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: A bare email address isEmailAddress accepts.
- `hasHeaderControlCharacters` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: True when `value` contains a code point ≤ 31 or 127 — unsafe in any HTTP header.
- `hasTextControlCharacters` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: True when `value` contains a code point ≤ 31 other than TAB/LF/CR, or 127 — unsafe in stored free text.
- `headerSafeString` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: `string` that is safe to place in a header value (no control characters at all).
- `honeypotField` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: The honeypot field: present and an empty string.
- `isEmailAddress` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: True when `value` is a bare email address (`jane@example.com`, no display name) that `@spy4x/email` would send to: a dot-atom local part and a dotted domain of at least two labels (`user@localhost` is refused), at most `MAX_ADDR_SPEC_LENGTH` (254) characters, the limit `@spy4x/email/address` exports.
- `isHoneypotFilled` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: True when a honeypot field was filled in, i.e. the submission is very likely automated.
- `isValidTimeZoneName` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: True when `Intl.DateTimeFormat` accepts `value` as a time zone.
- `textSafeString` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: `string` that is safe as free text: TAB, LF and CR are allowed.
- `timeZoneName` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/platform/validation/predicates`: A time zone name `Intl` accepts.

### `jsr:@spy4x/realtime`

- `AckTimeoutError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime`: Timed out waiting for an acknowledgement.

- `ApplyOutcome` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime`: Outcome of applying one pushed sequence.
- `ApplyStatus` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime`: What the cursor tracker decided about one pushed sequence.

### `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`

- `Change` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: What a person did to an entity.
- `ConflictReason` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: Why a write stopped the queue for its entity and now waits for a person: - `version`: the entity changed on the server since this write was based on it; - `gone`: the entity was deleted on the server; - `rejected`: the server refused the write (for example the role no longer allows it).
- `ConflictRef` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: The conflict a person was shown: an OutboxEntry from `entries()` fits.
- `LockManagerLike` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: The part of a browser's `LockManager` the outbox uses.
- `Outbox` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: The outbox as the app uses it.
- `OutboxCommand` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: The command the app sends for one entry.
- `OutboxEntry` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: One write made while offline, waiting to be sent.
- `OutboxKind` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: What an outgoing write does to an entity.
- `OutboxLock` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: Runs `work` while no other caller holds the queue.
- `OutboxPorts` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: What the outbox needs from the outside.
- `OutboxStore` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: Where the queue is kept.
- `Outcome` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: How a change ended for the person who made it.
- `SendFailure` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: How the outbox reads a failed send: - `unreachable`: the outcome is unknown or the server was busy; keep the entry and stop; - `version`: the write was based on a version the server has moved past; - `not-found`: the entity does not exist on the server; - `already-exists`: a create hit an id that is taken; - `rejected`: the server refused it for good; `message` says why.
- `createMemoryOutboxStore` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: A store in memory, with the behaviour of the IndexedDB one that the queue relies on.
- `createOutbox` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: The queue: see the module documentation for the rules it keeps.
- `createPromiseLock` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: A lock for one tab: runs the work one piece at a time, in the order asked.
- `createWebLock` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/realtime/outbox`: A lock shared by every tab of one browser, through Web Locks.

- `DEFAULT_OAUTH_FLOW_KEY_PREFIX` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: The key prefix createKvOAuthFlowStore writes under by default.
- `KvOAuthFlowStoreOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Options of createKvOAuthFlowStore.
- `MAX_PENDING_OAUTH_FLOWS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Most flows the memory store keeps pending at once; the oldest is dropped beyond this.
- `MemoryOAuthFlowStoreOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Options of createMemoryOAuthFlowStore.
- `OAuthAuthorization` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: A started flow: send the browser to `url`, and keep `state` in an HttpOnly cookie until the callback.
- `OAuthCallbackInput` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: What the app passes from the callback request.
- `OAuthFailure` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Why a callback was refused.
- `OAuthFlowKv` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: The key-value client createKvOAuthFlowStore needs.
- `OAuthFlowStore` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Keeps started flows until their callback.
- `OAuthOutcome` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: How a successful callback resolved the person.
- `OAuthPendingFlow` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: What a started flow needs at its callback.
- `OAuthPendingSignUp` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: A callback that would have created a user, with `signUp: "confirm"`.
- `OAuthProfile` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: What a provider says about the person who signed in, read from its user-info response.
- `OAuthProfileContext` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: What OAuthProviderConfig.completeProfile may use.
- `OAuthProviderConfig` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: One provider, supplied by the app.
- `OAuthSignIn` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Sign-in with one provider.
- `OAuthSignInError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Thrown by OAuthSignIn.handleCallback.
- `OAuthSignInOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Options of createOAuthSignIn.
- `OAuthSignInResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: A successful callback: the session, plus how the person was resolved and what the provider said.
- `OAuthTakenFlow` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: A flow OAuthFlowStore.take returns: the flow as it was put, and its expiry.
- `createKvOAuthFlowStore` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: A flow store on a shared key-value client, so a callback can land on any process that shares it.
- `createMemoryOAuthFlowStore` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: The in-process store `createOAuthSignIn` uses when it is given none.
- `createOAuthSignIn` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: Creates sign-in with one provider.
- `pkceChallenge` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/auth/oauth`: The S256 code challenge: base64url (unpadded) of the SHA-256 of the verifier (RFC 7636).

### `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`

- `ConfigError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: Raised by loadConfig when one or more environment variables are missing, blank, or fail the schema.

- `EnvReader` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: Reads environment values.

- `createEnvReader` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: An `EnvReader` over a fixed record — what a unit test injects instead of the process environment, so a config or middleware test runs under `--allow-read --allow-env` without any environment variable actually being set.
- `loadConfig` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: Read every environment variable `schema` declares and validate them together, once.
- `readEnvVar` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: Read one required value now, outside a schema — for the one variable a caller needs before the rest of its configuration can even be assembled (`ENV`, deciding which schema to validate against, for example).
- `stringBoolean` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: `"true"` or `"false"`, exactly — an environment boolean written by a person or a deploy script, not inferred from `"1"`, `"yes"` or an empty string.
- `systemEnv` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/config`: The process environment.

### `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`

- `AES_ALGORITHM` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: WebCrypto algorithm name.
- `AES_KEY_BYTES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Key size in bytes.
- `CryptoError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: The one error this module throws.
- `CryptoErrorCode` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Failure classes of this module.
- `CryptoService` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: AES-256-GCM cipher with two entry points that produce **different** keys from the same characters:
- `DEFAULT_MASK_VISIBLE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Default number of trailing code points maskKey is asked to leave visible.
- `HEX_KEY_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Length of a hex-encoded AES_KEY_BYTES-byte key.
- `IV_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: IV size in bytes: 96 bits, the size recommended for GCM.
- `KEY_BITS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Key size in bits, passed to `crypto.subtle.importKey`.
- `MASK_LENGTH` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Code points in every non-empty hint maskKey returns, whatever the key is.
- `MASK_VISIBLE_DIVISOR` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: A hint shows at most one trailing code point per this many code points of the key, so a short key reveals proportionally less than a long one.
- `MAX_MASK_VISIBLE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Trailing code points maskKey may ever show, whatever a caller asks for.
- `SecretCipher` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: The port `server/user-secrets.ts` depends on: any cipher (this AES-GCM one, a KV-backed one, a KMS or HSM client) satisfies the shape, so the caller never names a concrete implementation.
- `isHexKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: True when `hex` is exactly HEX_KEY_LENGTH hex characters.
- `maskKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/crypto`: Display hint for a key: MASK_LENGTH code points, a run of asterisks followed by a few trailing code points of the key, so a user recognises which key is stored without the hint standing in for the key.

- `SqliteMigrationDriver` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: The SQLite half of the migration runner.
- `SqliteOpenOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: Options accepted by a driver factory.
- `SqliteRunResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: What a write reports back: the driver's own counts, unconverted.
- `SqliteSchema` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: One schema, applied either once or through a caller-supplied upgrade.
- `SqliteScopeEndedError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: Thrown when a handle is used after the transaction it belongs to has ended.
- `SqliteStatement` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: One prepared statement.
- `SqliteTransactionWaitError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: Thrown when a statement waited out SqliteDbOptions.transactionWaitMs.
- `TransactionStatements` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: How a transaction is opened and closed, per driver dialect.
- `applySqliteSchema` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: Apply `schema` idempotently.
- `openSqliteDb` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/db/sqlite`: Open a connection, create its directory, and apply the two pragmas.

### `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`

- `AGE64_PREFIX` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Prefix every encrypted value carries: `KEY=age64:<base64>`.
- `AgeKey` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: `.age/key.txt`'s two pieces once resolved for a root: where it is, and what it decrypts with.
- `AgeStatus` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: A project's env-encryption posture: what files exist and whether a key is available.

- `EnvEntry` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: One line of a parsed env file.
- `GenerateAgeKeyResult` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Result of generateAgeKey: where the key landed, and its recipient (safe to share).
- `UnsupportedEnvSyntaxError` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Thrown by parseEnvFile on anything it can't safely round-trip.
- `ageStatus` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Inspect `root`'s env files and key, without decrypting anything.
- `decryptEnvFiles` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Decrypt every `.env*.age` file under `root` to its plaintext sibling, mode `0600`.
- `decryptValue` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Decrypt an `age64:<base64>` value with `identity` (an `AGE-SECRET-KEY-1...` string).
- `encryptEnvFiles` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Re-encrypt every `.env*` file under `root` to its `.env.age` sibling, mode `0644`, reusing unchanged ciphertext byte-for-byte.
- `encryptValue` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Encrypt one value for `recipient` (an `age1...` string).
- `generateAgeKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Generate a fresh identity and write it to `<root>/.age/key.txt`, mode `0600`.
- `isAge64Value` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: True when `value` is an `age64:...` ciphertext rather than plaintext.
- `parseEnvFile` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Parse an env file's content into entries.
- `readAgeKey` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/env-age64`: Read and parse the `.age/key.txt` that applies to `root` (see resolveKeyFile).

### `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`

- `DEFAULT_LOCKOUT_POLICY` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: 5 free failures, then 15 minutes doubling up to one day; 7 quiet days reset the count.
- `Lockout` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: The begin, fail and refund flow over one store and one policy.
- `LockoutOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: Options for createLockout.

- `LockoutStore` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: Where counters live: `@spy4x/server/lockout/memory-store` and `@spy4x/server/lockout/postgres`.
- `LockoutSubject` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: The caller's key for whatever is being guessed: a user id, an e-mail address, a device.
- `MAX_LOCK_LIMIT_MS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: The longest LockoutPolicy.maxLockMs accepted: one year, far inside a `Date`'s range.
- `beginCheck` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: The state after Lockout.begin counted a check at `now`, and the wait it returns.
- `createLockout` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: Builds the Lockout flow.
- `lockDelayMs` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: How long a subject is locked after its `failures`-th wrong guess in a row: nothing up to LockoutPolicy.freeFailures, then LockoutPolicy.firstLockMs doubling per failure, capped at LockoutPolicy.maxLockMs.
- `resolveLockoutPolicy` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/lockout`: DEFAULT_LOCKOUT_POLICY with `overrides` applied.

- `MAX_PASSWORD_BYTES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Longest password accepted, in UTF-8 bytes.
- `MAX_SESSION_MINUTES` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Longest session: 400 days, the most a browser keeps a cookie and the most Hono's cookie helper accepts.
- `NOT_AUTHENTICATED` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Body of the 401 response when there is no valid session.
- `NOT_AUTHORIZED` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Body of the 403 response when the app's check refuses.
- `NewSessionFields` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: What an app supplies to create a session: its own fields, without what the manager sets.
- `PasswordCheck` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Outcome of PasswordHasher.verify.
- `PasswordHasher` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Hashes and verifies passwords under one pepper and iteration count.
- `PasswordHasherOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Options for createPasswordHasher.
- `SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Body of the 401 response when the second factor is still owed.
- `SESSION_COOKIE_NAME` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Default name of the signed session cookie, as in the template.
- `SecondFactorStatus` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Second-factor state of a session.
- `SessionCookie` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Reads, writes and clears the session cookie on a Hono context.
- `SessionCookieOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Options for SessionCookie.
- `SessionManager` (class), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Creates, validates, extends and ends sessions over an app-supplied SessionStore.
- `SessionManagerOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Options for SessionManager.
- `SessionRecord` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: The fields the session logic reads.
- `SessionStatus` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Lifecycle of a stored session.
- `SessionStore` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Persistence for sessions, implemented by the app.
- `TOTP_DIGITS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Digits in a code.
- `TOTP_PERIOD_SECONDS` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Seconds per time step.
- `TOTP_WINDOW` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Steps accepted on either side of the current one, to absorb clock drift.
- `TotpAccount` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: How the account appears in the authenticator app.
- `TotpEnrolment` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: What a user needs to add the account to an authenticator app.
- `TotpVerifyOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Options for verifyTotp.
- `USER_ID_COOKIE_NAME` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Default name of the readable user-id cookie, as in the template.
- `ValidSession` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: A session that passed SessionManager.validate.
- `createAuth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Builds the session middleware and guards over one SessionManager and SessionCookie.
- `createPasswordHasher` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Creates a PasswordHasher.
- `generateTotpSecret` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: A new random secret: 20 bytes, base32 without padding (32 characters).
- `secondFactorSatisfied` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Whether a session's second-factor status lets a request through.
- `totpEnrolment` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: The enrolment link and QR code for a secret.
- `verifyTotp` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/server/sign-in`: Checks a code against a secret at the current time.

## @spy4x/time

### `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`

- `dayInMonth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: The same day number in the month `date` falls in, clipped to that month's length.
- `daysInMonth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: How many days the month `date` falls in has.
- `endOfMonth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Last day of the month `date` falls in — 28, 29, 30 or 31, leap year included.
- `endOfQuarter` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Last day of the calendar quarter `date` falls in.
- `endOfYear` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Last day of the calendar year `date` falls in.
- `formatIsoDate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: The `YYYY-MM-DD` calendar date of midnight-UTC milliseconds.
- `isSameDay` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Whether two values name the same calendar day.
- `isValidDateRange` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Whether a range is two real dates in order.
- `monthFirstWeekday` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Weekday of the first of `date`'s month, counted from the week's own first day.
- `parseIsoDate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: Midnight UTC of a calendar date, in milliseconds.
- `shiftMonth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: The first day of the month `months` away from `date`.
- `startOfMonth` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: First day of the month `date` falls in.
- `startOfQuarter` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: First day of the calendar quarter `date` falls in.
- `startOfYear` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/date`: First day of the calendar year `date` falls in.

### `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`

- `IcsAddress` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: A calendar address: a bare mailbox address, e.g. `jane@example.com`.
- `IcsAttendee` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: One `ATTENDEE` property with its optional iTIP parameters.
- `IcsEvent` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: The single VEVENT to serialise.
- `IcsEventStatus` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: RFC 5545 §3.8.1.11 `STATUS` property for a VEVENT.
- `IcsMethod` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: RFC 5545 §3.7.2 iTIP method carried by the `METHOD` property.
- `IcsOptions` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: Calendar-level properties and the values this writer cannot infer.
- `IcsPartStat` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: RFC 5545 §3.2.12 `PARTSTAT` participation status.
- `IcsRole` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: RFC 5545 §3.2.16 `ROLE` parameter values for an attendee.
- `attendeeLine` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: Build the `ATTENDEE` property for an attendee, including whichever of `CN`, `ROLE`, `PARTSTAT` and `RSVP` the caller supplied.
- `buildVEventLines` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: Build the VEVENT property lines, in RFC 5545 §3.6.1 order.
- `generateIcs` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: Serialise one event into a complete iCalendar document.
- `organizerLine` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics`: Build the `ORGANIZER` property for an address, quoting `CN` per RFC 5545 §3.2.5 and escaping it per RFC 6868.

### `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`

- `CONTINUATION_LIMIT` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Octets available to a continuation line: a continuation is prefixed with one SPACE (RFC 5545 §3.1), and that SPACE counts toward the 75-octet limit.
- `CRLF` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: RFC 5545 §3.1 requires CRLF as the content-line separator.
- `FOLD_LIMIT` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Maximum octets of a content line *excluding* its CRLF line break, per RFC 5545 §3.1 ("Lines of text SHOULD NOT be longer than 75 octets, excluding the line break").
- `LF` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Bare LF.
- `assertFoldable` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Assert that a logical line fits one physical content line.
- `foldLine` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Fold one logical content line to at most FOLD_LIMIT octets per physical line, per RFC 5545 §3.1.
- `formatIcsUtc` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Format a `Date` as an RFC 5545 UTC DATE-TIME value, `YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ`.
- `icsEscape` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Escape a TEXT property value per RFC 5545 §3.3.11.
- `icsEscapeParameter` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Escape a quoted parameter value per RFC 6868.
- `icsUnescape` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Reverse icsEscape.
- `icsUnescapeParameter` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Reverse icsEscapeParameter per RFC 6868 §3.1: `^n` becomes a newline, `^'` a double quote, `^^` a single caret.
- `joinContentLines` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Fold each logical line and terminate every one with CRLF, including the last.
- `stripControlCharacters` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Remove characters RFC 5545 does not allow in content lines: C0 controls except HTAB, LF and CR, plus DEL.
- `unfoldLines` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/ics-core`: Unfold every content line in an iCalendar document: a CRLF (or bare LF) followed by SPACE or HTAB continues the previous line (RFC 5545 §3.1).

### `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`

- `WeekdayLabel` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`: One weekday header: what its column shows, and what that abbreviation stands for.
- `dayLabel` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`: Localised "23 August 2026", the date as a person reads it.
- `localeFirstWeekday` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`: The day the locale's week starts on, `1` = Monday … `7` = Sunday.
- `monthLabel` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`: Localised "August 2026" for the month `date` falls in.
- `weekdayLabels` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/locale`: Seven localised weekday labels, starting on the locale's own first day.

### `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`

- `WallClockKind` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: How often a wall clock occurs in a zone on its date.
- `WallClockResolution` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: The answer of resolveWallClock.
- `addDays` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Add `n` days to a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, in `tz` when one is given.
- `canonicalTimeZone` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: `tz` with its spelling normalised where that is safe, never renamed to another zone name.
- `canonicalTimeZoneOr` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: canonicalTimeZone of `value` when it is a real zone, `fallback` otherwise.
- `canonicalValidTimeZoneOrNull` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: canonicalTimeZone of `value`, or `null` when it is missing or not a zone this runtime knows.
- `dayOfWeek` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Abbreviated weekday name in `tz`, uppercased: `"FRI"`.
- `formatDateLong` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Format a date as `"Friday, 28 August 2026"` — the date-only row of a confirmation view.
- `formatDateTimeLong` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Format the wall clock `date` + `time` in `tz` as a long human string.
- `formatDateTimeShort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Compact form for email subjects and buttons: `"Fri 28 Aug 04:00"`.
- `formatInstantLong` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Format an instant in `tz` as a long human string: `"Friday, 28 August 2026 at 04:00"`.
- `formatInstantShort` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Compact form of an instant in `tz`: `"Fri 28 Aug 04:00"`.
- `formatTimeOfDay` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Format a wall clock as 24-hour time-of-day, `"11:00"`.
- `hhmmInTz` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: `HH:MM` as `tz` reads the instant `instant`.
- `isValidTimeZone` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: True when `tz` is a zone this runtime's tzdata knows.
- `isoDateInTz` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: `YYYY-MM-DD` as `tz` reads the instant `instant`.
- `minToHHMM` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Minutes since midnight to a zero-padded `"HH:MM"`.
- `resolveWallClock` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Tells whether `tz`'s wall clock reads `date` + `time` once, never or twice, and gives the instants.
- `todayInTz` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: `YYYY-MM-DD` for today in `tz`.
- `tzOffsetMinutes` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: Minutes east of UTC for `tz` at the instant `instant`.
- `validTimeZoneOr` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: `tz` when it is a real IANA zone, `fallback` otherwise.
- `zoneCity` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: The last path segment of an IANA zone name with underscores as spaces: `America/New_York` is `New York`, `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh` is `Ho Chi Minh`, `UTC` is `UTC`.
- `zoneOffsetLabel` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: The offset of `tz` at `at` as `UTC+7`, `UTC-4`, `UTC+5:30` or `UTC+0`.
- `zonedDateTime` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/time/tz`: The instant at which `tz`'s wall clock reads `date` + `time`.

- `isValid` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Whether no field carries an issue.
- `sameValidation` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Whether two validation models carry the same issues.
- `schemaIssues` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: The issues arktype reported for a value, keyed by the model field they belong to.
- `setFieldIssue` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Set or clear one issue on one field, leaving that field's other issue types alone.
- `toValidationError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Build a ValidationError from arktype's issues.
- `validate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Parse `value` with an arktype schema exactly once.
- `validateSchema` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation`: Validate a model against its schema and fold the result into a validation model.

### `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`

- `FORM_FIELD` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Key an issue with no single field is reported under.
- `FieldIssue` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: One issue on one field.
- `FieldValidation` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Issues of one field, keyed by issue type.
- `ValidationModel` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Issues of a whole model, keyed by field name.
- `ValidationType` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Issue kinds the schema itself reports.
- `isValid` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Whether no field carries an issue.
- `sameValidation` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Whether two validation models carry the same issues.
- `schemaIssues` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: The issues arktype reported for a value, keyed by the model field they belong to.
- `setFieldIssue` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Set or clear one issue on one field, leaving that field's other issue types alone.
- `validateSchema` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/model`: Validate a model against its schema and fold the result into a validation model.

### `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`

- `ErrType` (enum), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Kind of a failed operation.
- `SchemaInput` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Value a schema accepts as input, before parsing.
- `SchemaOutput` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Value a schema produces after parsing, morphs applied.
- `VALIDATION_MESSAGE` (constant), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: The sentence every ValidationError shows the user, whatever the fields said.
- `ValidationError` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Submitted data the schema rejected.
- `ValidationIssue` (interface), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: One schema issue, flattened for display next to a form field.
- `ValidationIssues` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Issues keyed by field path.
- `ValidationResult` (type), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Outcome of validate: the parsed value, or the error that rejected it.
- `firstIssueMessage` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: First issue message in a validation error, in the order arktype reports them.
- `isArkErrors` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Whether a value is an arktype rejection, without relying on `instanceof`.
- `toValidationError` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Build a ValidationError from arktype's issues.
- `validate` (function), `jsr:@spy4x/validation/validate`: Parse `value` with an arktype schema exactly once.
